labels: READ = source-read this session (path:line); RECORDED = from session record; EXTERNAL = gate outside repo

findings.title: Android production key generation always throws; enrollment stops at CryptoReviewRequired before any network call
findings.recommendation: After crypto review approval, implement the approved generator + keystore instantiation + challenge client wiring (see MOB-012).

findings.title: iOS proof provider returns empty keys; bootstrap and session are structurally unreachable
findings.recommendation: Implement real proof keys after crypto approval; until then keep fail-closed.

findings.title: pca:// custom scheme is not registered (no CFBundleURLTypes); custom-scheme links can never launch the app
findings.evidence: ios/PCA.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj:255-256 (GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE; no INFOPLIST_KEY_CFBundleURLTypes); grep CFBundleURLTypes across ios/** = 0
findings.recommendation: Register the URL scheme (INFOPLIST_KEY_CFBundleURLTypes or a physical Info.plist) so the published link format can open the app.

findings.title: Enrollment link host enroll.pca.app is an unowned placeholder; no AASA/assetlinks hosting exists
findings.recommendation: Own a domain, host AASA + assetlinks, update host literals/entitlements; keep pca:// as interim on Android only.

findings.title: applyVerifiedPolicy has no caller in production; synced policy envelopes are never applied
findings.recommendation: Wire inbound feed -> decrypt -> ShieldPolicyValidator -> apply; add an integration test that fails if the call site disappears.

findings.title: No FamilyActivityPicker UI anywhere; FamilyActivitySelectionStore unused in production
findings.evidence: grep FamilyActivityPicker( across ios/** = 0; FamilyActivitySelectionStore.swift:28-52; only test usage RemainingAdaptersTests.swift:79
findings.recommendation: Add picker presentation + selection persistence before device UAT of shielding.

findings.title: Scheduling is a fixed all-day envelope with empty events; window/threshold mapper functions are dead
findings.recommendation: Drive schedules/events from real policy once policy application lands (MOB-005).

findings.title: Revocation never calls ManagedSettingsAdapter.removeAll; a shield could outlive its authority
findings.recommendation: Clear shields on authorization revocation and on policy withdrawal.

findings.title: Inbound ack endpoint implemented but never called
findings.recommendation: Ack applied messages; define retry semantics for unacked ones.

findings.title: Device identity persisted in UserDefaults rather than Keychain
findings.recommendation: Move to Keychain for durability/consistency (not a secret, but part of device trust state).

findings.title: FamilyKeyMaterialStore composed but its only writer has no production caller; DSK/DEK never persisted
findings.recommendation: Wire key material persistence with the crypto-approval slice.

findings.title: Real sync transport never instantiated; port is the always-OFFLINE placeholder
findings.evidence: PcaAppGraph.kt:1040,1063; FamilySyncRuntimePort.kt:57-66; ReconnectSyncOrchestrator/DeviceSessionManager/HttpUrlConnectionRelayHttpClient never constructed in src/main
findings.recommendation: Compose the orchestrator + session manager + transport, or record an owner decision deferring sync.

findings.title: VPN enforcement controller constructed but never invoked; policy marked OWNER_DECISION_PENDING
findings.recommendation: Owner decision: enforce, degrade, or defer VPN-based web filtering.

findings.title: Web-rule consumer has no production feeder; signed-rule verifier never approves
findings.recommendation: Either wire the delivery path or document filtering as local-only until delivery exists.

findings.title: No de-enrollment / device-removal path; Revoked state is never written
findings.evidence: EnrollmentCoordinator.kt:376 (only FamilyStateStore writer); grep de-enroll paths = none; Revoked only read :87
findings.recommendation: Define removal semantics (local + server) before UAT.

findings.title: Success path persists familyId as empty string (documented KNOWN_GAP)
findings.recommendation: Resolve the familyId contract with backend before sync composition.

findings.title: No BOOT_COMPLETED receiver; nothing re-arms the runtime after reboot until the process restarts
findings.evidence: grep BOOT_COMPLETED|RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED in android/** (main) = none; BootInstanceSource.kt:38-46 reads BOOT_COUNT only
findings.recommendation: Add boot re-arm (respecting battery policy) or document the limitation.

findings.title: Wellbeing app-based triggers inert (empty eligibleAppPackages); ParentPolicySyncCoordinator not composed
findings.recommendation: Populate eligible packages and compose the parent-policy coordinator with the sync slice.

findings.title: Neither client calls the enrollment invitation-state transitions the backend exposes
findings.recommendation: Wire install/app-installed/authorization-required reporting into the continuation flow.

findings.title: No device attestation (Play Integrity / App Attest) anywhere; identity is nonce signature only
findings.recommendation: Record as an explicit design decision or plan attestation as a hardening slice.

findings.title: Physical Android UAT job has never run; no self-hosted runner registered
findings.evidence: mobile-device-uat-core.yml:494 label pca-android-device; run history + gh runners = 0 [RECORDED]
findings.recommendation: Register runner PCA-Android-Device-01, then dispatch with run_android_physical=true.

findings.title: iOS cannot produce a signed device build (no DEVELOPMENT_TEAM; entitlement external)
findings.recommendation: Owner: Apple team + Family Controls approval, then on-device validation on a Mac.

findings.title: Release APK unsigned without owner keystore env vars
findings.recommendation: Owner supplies keystore pipeline for any distributable artifact.

findings.title: Asymmetric client-side token validation (iOS enforces 43-char base64url; Android does not)
findings.recommendation: Align validation (or document the asymmetry) to keep error surfaces consistent.

findings.title: Cross-layer (PP-F01): the enrollment link Parent Web generates in production is http://localhost:4000/enroll/<token>; it can never launch the Android app via any supported link shape
findings.evidence: LIVE parent bundle deviceEnrollmentLinkBaseUrl:"http://localhost:4000/enroll"; parent-web/src/config/env.ts:79; usage pages/family/devices/enrollmentState.tsx:191-192 and AddDeviceWizard.tsx:560-586; Android EnrollmentLinkParser.kt (pca://enroll?token= | https://enroll.pca.app/<token>); pca_parent_platform register PP-F01 / risk R-PP-02
findings.status: OPEN (cross-layer: parent-web fix + Android host decision + domain/assetlinks + crypto gate)
findings.recommendation: Fix the Parent Web production link base (guard + documented env var), then align the Android App-Link host; re-run the mobile enrollment assessment afterward (still blocked by MOB-001 until the crypto review clears).
